text_block_list.text: The time has finally come for Mihono Bourbon and I to take on the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: My first objective in the Twinkle Series is to win the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I wish to continue gradually strengthening my body in order to achieve this goal.
We're here to win the Triple Crown and prove that one can supplement stamina through hard work.
Our training begins today!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant, pant!
Some figures standing off in the distance are watching Bourbon as she trains vigorously.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, it's Bourbon. She's going at it hard again today.

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text: I know, right? She runs six inclines every day. That kind of workload is almost worrying…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes, Master!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant…
choice_data_list: Just one more lap! You've got this!
Just one more lap! You've got this!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your hard work today, Master…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I am merely following the training regimen you provided.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Your efforts deserve more praise than mine.
choice_data_list: You're the one out there putting in the work.
You're the one out there putting in the work.

text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon's training regimen is very strict compared to that of other runners.
I doubt there are many who can do what she does without complaint.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much.
Her usually unemotional expression softens a bit.
choice_data_list: We're going to take the Twinkle Series by storm!
We're going to take the Twinkle Series by storm!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Right!
The arduous training is certainly helping her progress.
choice_data_list: (We've got to work hard tomorrow too!)

text_block_list.text: Just as I'm heading to my office to further refine Bourbon's training regimen…

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. Do you have a moment?
I'm stopped by a fellow trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: Are you sure it's okay to put Mihono Bourbon through such brutal stamina training?

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: So you say, but…
He gives me a troubled look and scratches his head.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: She is very obedient—some might say oddly so. I've heard rumors you're taking advantage of that.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: Plus, she's a sprinter no matter how you look at her. Don't let her potential go to waste.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: …Really?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Really.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Winning the Triple Crown is a dream I originally shared with my father. Now, my master is chasing that dream with me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master's meticulous training has allowed me to reliably improve my cardiopulmonary functions.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: In addition to training for consistent completion times of medium- and long-distance races…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I recently recorded a time of one minute and thirty-five seconds in a 1,600-meter run. This is a competitive time for junior year.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I surmise that these are the results brought about by Master's belief in my strength.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Furthermore, I currently have no problems with my mental or physical health.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: In short, I am "okay."
Mihono Bourbon speaks this entire monologue in nearly a single breath, leaving my master colleague dumbfounded.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: …Haha, I didn't expect a lecture from you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: This was not a "lecture." I merely communicated the facts.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: …Right. Okay, I'm sorry. That was insensitive of me.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: I was just a bit worried because it seemed like you were being forced to run beyond your breaking point.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: But I can see you really trust your master. Stay safe at the Twinkle Series, then. I'll be rooting for you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you.
After saying his piece, the master leaves.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I do not understand the intention behind your expression of gratitude. I merely corrected a misunderstanding.
choice_data_list: I'm just happy to know that you trust me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …I am not well-versed in such things.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However, I have determined that your instructions are essential for running in long-distance races.
choice_data_list: That means you believe in me.
That means you believe in me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I see… So that's what it is.
And with that, Mihono Bourbon and I embark on a long journey to chase after our dream!
